turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
How did that feel for you?
I told my boss Gareth about the problem, because I was afraid he would find out through my accounts.
What happened next?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. That is how it was.
And how was that for you?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
How did that feel for you?
It is thirty days without a bet and Meera noticed and said well done.
Tell me more about that.
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I keep coming back to it.
Tell me more about that.
Meera moved back into our bedroom on Thursday, but she says it does not mean everything is forgiven.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I think so, yes.
What happened next?
I sleep five or six hours now because the debt has a plan.
Mm-hm. Go on.
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. That is how it was.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
